title: Project 1 A better me
text: A Tick or write down the good qualities you have. Then share an example with your classmates.
I'm honest. Last Sunday, I visited my grandparents. I broke Grandpa's favourite cup. Grandpa didn't know, but I felt bad. So I told him the truth.
